TOP 5 ANCHOR STORIES — EVENING, Friday 21 August 2026 (18:02 BST)

1. Trump's "economic warfare" on Iran hardens; China publicly refuses to back the
   sanctions campaign; Iran calls measures "illegal and inhumane". Oil spikes above
   $94 (highest since late July) then eases. [Iran War — Day 174 lead]
   Sources: Al Jazeera live 21 Aug; CNN live 20 Aug; Reuters/tradingeconomics markets.

2. UN Secretary-General Guterres warns Israel's E1 West Bank settlement is an
   "existential threat" to the two-state solution; France, Germany, Italy, the
   Netherlands, Norway and the UK issue a joint statement calling the tenders
   "unacceptable". (Evening advance of morning's E1 lead.)
   Sources: Al Jazeera; France 24 video; six-nation joint statement.

3. GCSE results day: top grades edge up (22.0% grade 7/A or above) while the
   standard pass rate dips again to 67.3%, completing the return to pre-pandemic
   grading. Post-16 resit rates fall. [Biggest UK domestic story of the day]
   Sources: BBC education; Schools Week; FE News.

4. Global markets: FTSE 100 closes +0.6% at 10,816.6 as miners rally on record gold;
   Brent eases from above $94; US Treasury bond-buyback weakens the dollar.
   Sources: Reuters/tradingeconomics; Bloomberg FTSE live blog 21 Aug.

5. Drought response escalates: National Drought Group moves to weekly meetings;
   71.3% of England in drought after the driest July in 190 years; Environment
   Agency logs 226 drought incidents. (Evening advance of morning Cobra story.)
   Sources: GOV.UK / Water Magazine / Environment Agency 21 Aug.

- UK July public borrowing overshoots forecast, sharpening autumn-budget squeeze [ONS].
- North Sea oil & gas decision falls to PM Burnham as consultation closes [Sky News].
